summary: Institutionalisation of Central Empowered Committee; reconstitution as permanent statutory body; environmental governance and monitoring; interpretation of 'forest' under Forest (Conservation) Act; monitoring of state compliance with forest conservation orders; powers of CEC for site inspections, evidence gathering, co-opting officials; statutory basis under Environment Protection Act; continuity of judicial oversight.
final_judgment: Notification dated 05.09.2023 approved; CEC institutionalised as permanent body; to function subject to Court's further directions; principles for environmental rule of law formulated.
